jobs.name: Scribble Fox
jobs.action: crouch anticipation, fast forward pounce with brush tail ink arc, extended strike, recover to standing
jobs.prompt: Create a production sprite sheet of EXACTLY SIXTEEN distinct poses arranged in a precise 4 column by 4 row equal-cell grid on an actual transparent alpha background. The approved character concept reference defines Scribble Fox; the second image is a layout aid only. Preserve this exact character, face, silhouette, palette, accessories, thick ink outlines and painted color texture, but REMOVE all paper backgrounds, shadows, captions, text and decorative scenery. Whole sheet generated together for consistent anatomy. EVERY pose faces RIGHT in a readable three-quarter side view, entire body and accessories within its cell with generous transparent padding. SAME scale in every cell, aligned body centers and grounded feet baseline. Row 1: four distinct subtle idle/breathing/bobbing poses. Rows 2 and 3: eight sequential moving/run/flying poses, visibly changing legs/flippers/tail/bubble/headphone motion as appropriate to this buddy. Row 4: four sequential special-assist poses: crouch anticipation, fast forward pounce with brush tail ink arc, extended strike, recover to standing. Do not substitute duplicates. No borders, grid lines, numbers, labels, paper texture background, floor shadows, checkerboard or other characters. Transparent areas must be truly transparent. Crisp expressive original game sprites with slightly simplified detail readable at 64 pixels.
